review.note: Retracted in M22: the killing of José Óscar de Vasconcelos on 18 April 1976, for which the import brought a date and a name and no description at all. The atlas holds no record of the armed far left — not the PRP-BR, not the FP-25, not the trials — so there is nothing for an action of theirs to attach to in either direction, and any edge would be invented. Revisit once the organisations themselves are here.
